(Nb, M)C (M = Mo, Hf, Cr) formed in a new AlCoCrFeNi1.9(Mo, Nb, Hf, C) HEA by adding Mo, Nb, Hf, C elements to the AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy. And it effectively improved the high temperature property of the alloy.
Therefore, the LPSO phase can significantly improve the tensile property of the alloy at room temperature, while no obvious improvement was found on the property at 973 K.
